primaryFocus: story-011 nudge incentive feature in BatchNFTMinter.sol

findings.title: ERC1155 onReceived hook in mint loop can drain BatchNFTMinter via live max-approval
Nudge payout via ERC777/hooked token enables reentrant batchMint with no guard
Anyone can frontrun a funded nudge balance by calling batchMint with their own recipient
Nudge token-equality guard does not protect against dispatcher's prime-token side-channel
NudgePaid event reports balance snapshot, not actual delivered amount, for fee-on-transfer or rebasing tokens
Configuring nudgePaymentToken without nudgeSize still triggers up-front equality guard, breaking same-token batches
Owner can frontrun a pending batchMint by changing nudgePaymentToken/nudgeSize, denying user incentive
setNudgePaymentToken does not validate that the new token implements IERC20
totalPaid return value misreports caller's spend when third-party donations are present

notesOnNFTStaker: NFTStaker.sol is well-protected with nonReentrant on stake/unstake/claim/emergencyWithdraw, a documented solvency invariant (balance == rewardBudget + committedDebt), and prior audit fixes M-01 (committedDebt accounting) and M-03 (staked-subset notional). No new cross-contract findings beyond what is already addressed by those fixes. setStakedId / setDispatcherIndex / setNFTMinter all gated on totalStaked == 0. emergencyWithdraw works while paused and skips _syncBudget so principal cannot be trapped.
deferredToOtherAgents: Economic / MEV severity calibration of CODE-003 (frontrunning the funded nudge pool) is also relevant to econ-scanner. Severity classification deferred to severity-classifier.
